adequacy_evidence.quote: Scientific adequacy: supported — the conclusion of no whole-brain-corrected vmPFC support follows from a defensible group model and correction, and is appropriately bounded by the supplied first-level estimates, common-support restriction, equal weighting, and approximate anatomical ROI.

hypothesis_conclusion.quote: Hypothesis outcome: In the 54-person NARPS equal-indifference group, where the potential-gain range was twice the potential-loss range, the participant gain-effect estimates provide no support for a positive vmPFC response to increasing potential gain under whole-brain familywise-error (FWE) correction.
